description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and property rights. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and title settlement, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
